title: 1 Thessalonians 4:17 — caught up (harpazo) and the word Rapture
summary: 1 Thessalonians 4:17 in English and Latin, with the Greek word harpazo (ἁρπάζω) explained as to seize, catch up, snatch away, and a note that the Latin rapiemur gives us the English word Rapture.

text.text: 17 Then we who are alive and remain will be caught up* together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air, and so we shall always be with the Lord.
to seize, catch up, snatch away
17 deinde nos qui vivimus qui relinquimur simul rapiemur cum illis in nubibus obviam Domino in aera et sic semper cum Domino erimus

words.gloss: to seize, catch up, snatch away
we shall be caught up (Latin Vulgate), source of the English word Rapture

keywords: meet the Lord in the air
